top_signals.title: FBI Arrests Executive at Ransomware Negotiation Firm
top_signals.summary: Agents with the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) on Thursday arrested the co-founder of a Canadian cybersecurity firm in connection with an investigation into the ShinyHunters hacking group that recently relieved the FBI of sensitive data on thousands of agents, multiple sources tell KrebsOnSecurity.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US Producer Prices Up Most Since 2022 as Energy Pain Worsens
top_signals.summary:
US producer prices rose in September at the fastest pace in more than four years as higher energy costs reverberated through the US economy.
The producer price index advanced 1.3% from a month earlier — the most since March 2022 — and 6.3% from a year earlier, according to Bureau of Labor Statistics data.
Stephanie Roth, Chief Economist at Wolfe Research, reacts to the data. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: ShinyHunters Extorted Boeing Spin-off Prior to Arrests
top_signals.summary: A teenager from Amman, Jordan suspected of leading the prolific data theft and extortion group ShinyHunters has been detained and is reportedly cooperating with the FBI to identify other members of the hacking gang. KrebsOnSecurity has learned that the suspect, who uses the hacker handle "Rey," was detained as ShinyHunters was in the process of extorting a business unit recently divested by the global aerospace company Boeing, which manufactures the fleet of planes used by the employer of Rey's father -- Royal Jordanian Airlines.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: 2026 Bloomberg New Economy Forum Highlights
top_signals.summary: After decades of geopolitical stability and relative predictability, the rules of global engagement are being rewritten. From October 13–15, the Bloomberg New Economy Forum brought together public-and private-sector leaders from around the world in New Delhi to examine: A World in Play: Defining the New Levers of Power. (Source: Bloomberg)
